newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 6.

text.p: WASHINGTON (March 5) - The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on March 6:
WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan said he wasn't trying to talk stock prices down last week, saying that is not possible.

WASHINGTON - If you own a computer, you've probably seen this message many times from software companies -- by breaking the "shrink wrap" of a newly purchased programme you are agreeing to the terms of a long and complexly worded license that the manufacturer has included.
WASHINGTON - Columbia Hospital for Women, faced with a dwindling patient load and a crushing debt of $23.5 million, has put itself on the auction block.
WASHINGTON - Coffee drinkers who crave the kick of caffeine should brace themselves -- the price of beans and brew is headed higher, possibly by as much as 20 percent, analysts say.
